manualFollowUps: Database: supabase db push --linked --include-all only from an isolated copy of the installed migrations plus 20261026171000_toefl_playbook_premium_guides_and_plans.sql, keeping the 9 pending payment migrations from #220 (20261010162000-20261010174000) and any other session's unreleased migrations excluded. Dry run first. Push it after the toefl-pb-modules release (20261026170000-20261026170999) so the six premium guides get their parent module pages; if it runs first, the guides are still inserted with parent_page_id null and only lose the module-to-guide link. Content only: 6 premium guides (visibility premium, 175 sections), 8 ETS sources (shared rows reused by url), 26 citations and 5 plan templates for product f9512c15-ec1c-4fcb-a5ec-a2c6ac3a020e. Every insert is on conflict do nothing.

Optional, if the parent links are missing because the order was reversed: update public.toefl_playbook_pages g set parent_page_id = p.id from public.toefl_playbook_pages p where g.slug like 'guide-%' and g.parent_page_id is null and g.module_key = p.slug and p.locale_code = 'en' and g.locale_code = 'en' and g.product_id = 'f9512c15-ec1c-4fcb-a5ec-a2c6ac3a020e';
verification: select slug, visibility, (select count(*) from toefl_playbook_page_sections s where s.page_id = p.id) from toefl_playbook_pages p where slug like 'guide-%' and product_id = 'f9512c15-ec1c-4fcb-a5ec-a2c6ac3a020e' returns the six guides, all premium, with 24, 25, 42, 22, 33 and 29 sections.

select slug, plan_type, duration_days from toefl_playbook_plan_templates where product_id = 'f9512c15-ec1c-4fcb-a5ec-a2c6ac3a020e' returns four-week-sprint 28, speaking-writing-priority 42, reading-listening-priority 42, eight-week-standard 56 and twelve-week-foundation 84, all published.
Signed out, GET /functions/v1/toefl-playbook/pages/guide-final-14-days is refused as premium; with a TOEFL Playbook entitlement it returns 29 sections and 6 sources.
node scripts/content/toefl-pb-premium.mjs --verify reports the migration in sync with content/toefl-playbook.
